verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents financial data APIs (account verification, balances, transactions), webhook event subscriptions, a sandbox Test Drive plan, and an MCP toolkit for developer Q&A and code generation. Nothing in it describes user-defined automations, let alone versioning, review, or rollback of them. Webhook subscriptions and sandbox testing are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
